events.comment:
POTION SHOP — scene events.
Game data (recipes, ingredients, customers, upgrades, balance) is in the project's global variables.
Tables, cauldrons, furniture and waypoints are placed in this scene: move them in the scene editor and the game adapts (the Order variable of TableSet/Cauldron is the purchase order).
Each JavaScript block below is one game system.
At the beginning of the scene: define the game systems, then start the game.
Every frame: run the simulation (customers, workers, brewing, interface).
